questions.question: Linux boot jarayonini quvvat yoqilishidan login'gacha tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: BIOS / UEFI: POST, hardware tekshiruvi, bootloader'ni MBR yoki EFI System Partition'dan o'qiydi.

questions.question: `systemd` nima va unit, target, timer nima?
questions.explanation: systemd — PID 1 bo'lib ishlaydigan init va service manager.

questions.question: Linux process holatlari (`R`, `S`, `D`, `Z`, `T`) qanday?
questions.explanation: R: CPU'da ishlayapti yoki run queue'da kutmoqda.

questions.question: Zombie process nima va qanday hal qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Tugagan, lekin parent wait()/waitpid() chaqirmagani uchun process jadvalida qolgan child. PID band qiladi, CPU/RAM sarflamaydi. Allaqachon o'lik — kill -9 ta'sir qilmaydi.

questions.question: Linux load average (1, 5, 15 daqiqa) nima?
questions.explanation: Runnable (CPU ishlatayotgan yoki kutayotgan) va uninterruptible sleep (D) (disk/NFS I/O kutayotgan) process'larning 1, 5, 15 daqiqalik eksponensial o'rtachasi.

questions.question: `top`, `htop` va `atop` farqi.
questions.explanation: top: standart real vaqt monitoring.

questions.question: Virtual xotira nima va paging qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Har process'ga o'zining xususiy, uzluksiz manzil maydonini beruvchi abstraksiya. Xotira qat'iy o'lchamli page'larga (odatda 4KB) bo'linadi; MMU page table'lar orqali virtual manzilni fizik RAM manziliga tarjima qiladi...

questions.question: Minor va major page fault farqi.
questions.explanation: Minor: page allaqachon RAM'da (masalan shared library, page cache) — faqat page table yangilanadi, disk I/O yo'q.

questions.question: Swap nima va `vm.swappiness` qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Xotira tugaganda RAM kengaytmasi sifatida ishlatiladigan disk joyi.

questions.question: Linux OOM Killer nima?
questions.explanation: RAM va swap tugaganda ishga tushadigan kernel mexanizmi: har process uchun xotira sarfi va oom_score_adj asosida oom_score hisoblab, eng yuqorisini SIGKILL bilan o'ldiradi. cgroup limitida ham ishlaydi (container OOMK...

questions.question: `/proc` fayl tizimi nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel xotirada dinamik yaratadigan psevdo-fayl tizimi (procfs): kernel ma'lumot strukturalari, process holatlari (/proc/<pid>/) va runtime parametrlar (/proc/sys) uchun interfeys.

questions.question: `/sys` (sysfs) nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel obyektlari, driver'lar va hardware quyi tizimlarining (block qurilmalar, tarmoq interfeyslari, quvvat holatlari) strukturali ierarxik daraxtini beruvchi psevdo-fayl tizimi.

questions.question: `systemctl` bilan servis lifecycle'i qanday boshqariladi?
questions.explanation: systemctl start|stop|restart|reload <service>

questions.question: Fayl ruxsatlari va octal yozuv (`chmod`) qanday?
SUID, SGID va sticky bit (octal bilan) nima?
questions.explanation: SUID (u+s / 4000): binary fayl egasi huquqi bilan bajariladi (/usr/bin/passwd root sifatida).

questions.question: Hard link va soft link (symlink) farqi.
questions.explanation: Hard link: shu fayl tizimidagi mavjud inode'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yana bir nom. Asl nom o'chsa ma'lumot qoladi; link count 0 bo'lgandagina o'chadi. Fayl tizimlararo va papkaga bo'lmaydi.

questions.question: Linux'da inode nima?
questions.explanation: Fayl metadata'sini saqlovchi struktura: hajm, egasi UID/GID, ruxsatlar, timestamp'lar (atime, mtime, ctime) va data block ko'rsatkichlari. Fayl nomi va mazmunini saqlamaydi (nom — papka yozuvida).

questions.question: `df -h` da joy bor, lekin "No space left on device" — qanday troubleshoot qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Fayl tizimida inode tugagan (millionlab kichik fayl: session, mail queue, cache). df -i bilan tekshiring; kichik keraksiz fayllarni o'chiring. Boshqa sabablar: o'chirilgan lekin ochiq turgan fayl (lsof +L1 — bu df da ...

questions.question: `atime`, `mtime` va `ctime` farqi.
questions.explanation: atime: fayl mazmuni oxirgi marta o'qilgan vaqt (relatime bilan kamroq yangilanadi).

questions.question: Linux Filesystem Hierarchy Standard (FHS) ni tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: /bin, /usr/bin: asosiy foydalanuvchi binary'lari.

questions.question: LVM nima va PV, VG, LV nima?
questions.explanation: Diskni qayta bo'lmasdan dinamik o'lchamini o'zgartirish imkonini beruvchi storage abstraksiyasi:

questions.explanation: # 1. Extend the Logical Volume by 50GB

questions.question: ext4, XFS va Btrfs farqi.
questions.explanation: ext4: sinalgan, ishonchli; kichraytirish (offline) va onlayn kengaytirishni qo'llaydi.

questions.explanation: Boot'da statik mount qoidalari:

questions.question: `noatime` mount opsiyasi nima va nega DB uchun ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Fayl o'qilganda inode atime yangilanishini o'chiradi — og'ir o'qishda ortiqcha yozish I/O yo'qoladi.

questions.question: `tmpfs` va `/dev/shm` nima?
questions.explanation: Fayllarni bevosita virtual xotirada (RAM/swap) saqlaydigan juda tez vaqtinchalik fayl tizimlari; reboot'da tozalanadi.

questions.question: `strace` nima va ishlab turgan process'ni qanday trace qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Process syscall'larini ushlab yozadigan diagnostika tool'i:

questions.question: `lsof` bilan ochiq fayl va socket'larni qanday topasiz?
questions.explanation: lsof -i :8080 — 8080 portni tinglayotgan process.

questions.question: `fuser` nima?
questions.explanation: Fayl, papka yoki socket'ni ishlatayotgan process'larni aniqlaydi (fuser -k 8080/tcp — 8080 portni ushlab turgan process'ni o'ldiradi).

questions.question: `vmstat` va undagi `bi`, `bo`, `wa`, `si`, `so` nima?
questions.explanation: bi/bo: block qurilmalardan o'qilgan / yozilgan block'lar (disk I/O).

questions.question: `iostat` va `%util` nima?
questions.explanation: Qurilma I/O yuklamasini ko'rsatadi. %util — qurilma band bo'lgan vaqt foizi; 100% ga yaqin — saturatsiya (SSD/NVMe parallel bo'lgani uchun await va aqu-sz muhimroq).

questions.question: `netstat` va `ss` farqi.
questions.explanation: ss — eski netstat ning tez almashtiruvchisi: /proc/net/ ni parse qilish o'rniga socket ma'lumotini kernel'dan (sock_diag) bevosita oladi.

questions.question: `ip` va `ifconfig` farqi.
questions.explanation: ip (iproute2) eski ifconfig o'rnini bosadi:

questions.question: `sar` nima?
questions.explanation: sysstat paketining qismi: CPU, xotira, tarmoq va disk unumdorligining tarixiy ma'lumotlarini yig'adi va hisobot beradi (sar -u, sar -r, sar -n DEV).

questions.question: `nice` va `renice` farqi.
questions.explanation: Process CPU scheduling prioritetini boshqaradi (niceness -20 eng yuqori dan 19 eng pastgacha, default 0):

questions.question: `kill`, `pkill` va `killall` farqi.
questions.explanation: kill <PID>: aniq PID'ga signal.

questions.question: Asosiy Linux signal'lari (`SIGTERM`, `SIGKILL`, `SIGHUP`, `SIGINT`, `SIGQUIT`) qanday?
questions.explanation: SIGTERM (15): graceful to'xtatish so'rovi; ushlab qayta ishlash mumkin.

questions.question: Core dump nima?
questions.explanation: Process yiqilgan paytdagi (segfault) xotira va registr holatining diskdagi snapshot'i — gdb bilan tahlil qilinadi (ulimit -c, coredumpctl).

questions.question: `gdb` nima?
questions.explanation: C/Go/Rust binary'lari va core dump'larda xotira, call stack va bajarilish nuqtalarini tekshiradigan interaktiv debugger (gdb /bin/app core.dump).

questions.question: `/etc/resolv.conf` nima?
questions.explanation: DNS stub resolver konfiguratsiyasi: nameserver'lar (nameserver 8.8.8.8), search domen'lari va opsiyalar (ndots:5).

questions.question: `/etc/hosts` nima?
questions.explanation: IP'larni hostname'larga map qiluvchi statik lokal jadval — odatda tashqi DNS'dan oldin tekshiriladi.

questions.question: `/etc/nsswitch.conf` nima?
questions.explanation: Name Service Switch: bazalar uchun qidiruv tartibi (hosts: files dns — avval /etc/hosts, keyin DNS; passwd: files ldap).

questions.question: `systemd-resolved` nima?
questions.explanation: Lokal nom resolution, DNS caching, LLMNR va DNS-over-TLS beradigan servis (127.0.0.53 stub).

questions.question: `iptables` arxitekturasi (table, chain, target) qanday?
questions.explanation: Table: filter, nat, mangle, raw.

questions.question: `nftables` nima?
questions.explanation: iptables, ip6tables, arptables ni yagona sintaksis, bitta CLI (nft) va kernel bytecode engine bilan almashtiradigan zamonaviy framework.

questions.question: `ufw` va `firewalld` farqi.
questions.explanation: ufw (Ubuntu/Debian): iptables/nftables uchun soddalashtirilgan CLI.

questions.question: `tcpdump` bilan paketlarni qanday ushlaysiz?
questions.explanation: tcpdump -i eth0 -nn -s0 -w capture.pcap port 443

questions.question: `iperf3` nima?
questions.explanation: Client va server orasidagi maksimal TCP/UDP throughput va paket yo'qotishini o'lchaydigan tool.

questions.question: `traceroute` va `mtr` farqi.
questions.explanation: traceroute: TTL'ni oshirib yuborib, marshrutdagi har hop'ni aniqlaydi.

questions.question: `/etc/security/limits.conf` nima?
questions.explanation: PAM orqali user/group resurs limitlari (ochiq fayllar nofile, process'lar nproc). systemd servislariga ta'sir qilmaydi — ular uchun unit'da LimitNOFILE.

questions.question: `chroot` jail nima?
questions.explanation: Process uchun root papkani (/) o'zgartirib, host fayl tizimining qolganidan ajratish (container'larning salafi; to'liq xavfsizlik chegarasi emas).

questions.question: `systemd-cgls` va `systemd-cgtop` nima?
questions.explanation: systemd-cgls: cgroup process ierarxiyasini daraxt ko'rinishida.

questions.question: `sysctl` va `/etc/sysctl.conf` nima?
questions.explanation: /proc/sys/ dagi kernel runtime parametrlarini ko'rish va o'zgartirish (sysctl -w, doimiy uchun /etc/sysctl.d/.conf va sysctl --system).

questions.question: `journalctl -k` nima?
questions.explanation: Journal'dan kernel ring buffer xabarlarini chiqaradi (dmesg ga o'xshash, lekin oldingi boot'lar uchun ham).

questions.question: `logrotate` (Linux admin) nima?
questions.explanation: Ilova log'larini rotatsiya qilish, siqish va eskisini o'chirishni avtomatlashtiradigan utilita (copytruncate yoki postrotate bilan signal).

questions.question: `rsyslog` va `systemd-journald` farqi.
questions.explanation: journald: systemd unit'lari log'larini binary strukturali formatda yig'adi.

questions.question: `auditd` nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel audit quyi tizimi: compliance va intrusion detection uchun xavfsizlik hodisalarini (fayl kirishi, ruxsat o'zgarishi, syscall) yozadi (auditctl, ausearch).

questions.question: `cron` va systemd timer farqi.
questions.explanation: systemd timer: dependency boshqaruvi, journald'da log, monotonic timer (boot'dan 10 daqiqa keyin), Persistent=true bilan o'tkazib yuborilgan run'larni bajarish, resurs limitlari. Cron sodda va hamma joyda bor.

questions.question: `sudo` va `su` farqi.
questions.explanation: su: boshqa foydalanuvchiga o'tadi, uning parolini so'raydi.
